key.name: show-top-bar-icon
key.description: Whether the standalone XmaX indicator button appears in the top bar. Off by default: the logo and readouts live in Quick Settings instead.

key.name: top-bar-icon-shows-temp
key.summary: Show CPU temperature in the top bar
key.description: Swap the standalone indicator's logo for a live °C label.

key.name: qs-show-logo
key.summary: Show the XmaX logo in Quick Settings
key.description: Whether the XmaX logo appears in the Quick Settings button in the top bar, next to the system status icons.

key.name: qs-metrics
key.description: Whether the XmaX readouts tile appears in Quick Settings.

key.name: qs-graph-window
key.description: Seconds of history shown in the System Stats usage graph (30, 60, 120 or 180).

key.name: graph-chart
key.description: What the System Stats usage graph charts: usage, temp, clock, memory or power.

key.name: graph-series
key.description: Series ids drawn in the usage graph's chart (see chartSeries.js).

key.name: qs-charge-limit
key.description: Whether the charge-limit control appears in Quick Settings.

key.name: qs-power-profile
key.description: Whether the power-profile control appears in Quick Settings.

key.name: charge-limit-selected
key.description: Charge limit percentage the Quick Settings menu applies (75-100).

key.name: charge-limit-values
key.description: Percentages offered in the charge-limit Quick Settings menu.
